links.outcome: Therapeutic recommendation concordance of molecular-AI versus phenotypic-AI optimized workflow
links.effect: Therapeutic concordance 81.4% (192/236; κ=0.55). Resistance discordance predicted therapeutic discordance (aOR 7.70). Phenotypic optimization ensured 100% appropriate therapy.
links.quote: The integrated strategy delivered appropriate therapy 33 hours earlier in 81.4% of cases without requiring adjustment, with phenotypic optimization ensuring 100% appropriate therapy.

links.outcome: Therapeutic recommendation concordance between molecular-AI guidance and phenotypic-AI optimization
links.effect: Therapeutic recommendation concordance was 81.4% (192/236; 95% CI: 75.9-85.8%; κ=0.55, moderate).
links.quote: Combined concordance rates were bacterial identification 94.5% (224/237; 95% CI: 90.8-96.8%; Cohen's κ=0.84, almost perfect), antimicrobial resistance 89.5% (212/237; 95% CI: 84.9–92.8%; κ=0.76, substantial), and therapeutic recommendations 81.4% (192/236; 95% CI: 75.9-85.8%; κ=0.55, moderate).

unlisted_practices: Combine rapid molecular-AI initial antimicrobial guidance with subsequent phenotypic susceptibility-informed AI optimization.
